channel.title: Chromasync — The Chromatic Breathing Sanctuary
channel.description: Scientific research, procedural audio/visual synthesis updates, and release logs for Chromasync.

item.title: Chromasync v1.0.0 Released — ~40 KB Zero-Bloat Chromatic Breathing Sanctuary
item.description: Chromasync v1.0.0 is now live on Web (PWA) and Android (direct APK). Built with pure WebGL GLSL shaders and real-time Web Audio DSP without external audio or texture files.

item.title: Resonance Breathing (~0.1 Hz) & Heart Rate Variability
item.description: How breathing at about 6 breaths per minute lines up with the baroreflex to maximise heart rate variability, and what the research shows.

item.title: The Vagus Nerve and the Long Exhale
item.description: Why heart rate falls during exhalation, how the vagus nerve slows the heart, and what is known about long-exhale patterns such as 4-7-8.

item.title: Box Breathing (4-4-4-4): What It Does and What It Does Not
item.description: How box breathing works, why slow breathing with pauses avoids over-breathing, and how it compares with other techniques in controlled studies.

item.title: 432 Hz vs 440 Hz: Physics, Myths and Studies
item.description: What separates music tuned to A = 432 Hz from A = 440 Hz, which claims hold up, and what the small studies actually found.

item.title: Binaural Beats: How They Work and What the Evidence Says
item.description: How the brain creates a binaural beat, why headphones are required, and what systematic reviews say about brainwave entrainment.
